message.text: Landed, merged into michael/dev. The file explorer already existed as ext/files (tree + highlighted source), so I extended it: the selected files now live in the URL, and a bar switches between 1 column, 2 columns (shift-click fills the second) and code + rendered (a .md or .html shows live beside its source). See it at /framework/ext/files/ and in the demo at /framework/ext/demo/ ("The code beside the render"); page and card folders get it through page-system's draw_folder(), same door. Shots at 1920 and 3440, before and after, are in the card folder. Left: I did not screenshot cards themselves.
